title: WaitStrategies.join sums component sleeps without overflow protection; a total >= 2^63 ms wraps negative and Retryer.call throws IllegalArgumentException
cause: CompositeWaitStrategy.computeSleepTime (built by WaitStrategies.join) adds component sleeps with plain long addition and no saturation or sign check, unlike the other arithmetic built-ins; Retryer.call passes the wrapped negative value unvalidated to the default ThreadSleepStrategy, whose Thread.sleep throws IllegalArgumentException, and call() catches only InterruptedException.
trigger: A joined wait strategy whose components sum to 2^63 ms or more on a failed attempt, e.g. join(fixedWait(Long.MAX_VALUE, MILLISECONDS), fixedWait(1, SECONDS)), join(fixedWait(Long.MAX_VALUE, DAYS), fixedWait(1, MILLISECONDS)), or join(exceptionWait(X.class, e -> SECONDS.toMillis(hint)), randomWait(1, SECONDS)) with a hint that saturates to Long.MAX_VALUE; built with RetryerBuilder and the default block strategy, callable fails once and is retried.
consequence: Retryer.call (and RetryerCallable via wrap) ends after one attempt with IllegalArgumentException("timeout value is negative") instead of waiting the documented total: an undocumented outcome that drops the attempt count and the last failure (no cause/suppressed link), and on an interrupted caller pre-empts the documented RetryException. The same components alone or with a saturating sum wait and, on interrupt, yield RetryException(1 attempt, last failure) with the interrupt status set.
premises: Code-review finding; no model-checking counterexample. Reproduced at escalation Level 0 through public API only, on the unmodified library at 177b6c9 built against Guava 22.0 and jsr305 2.0.2, on JDK 21.0.13.1 and JDK 11.0.33.1.
Component factories accept the triggering values: fixedWait checks only sleepTime >= 0 and TimeUnit.toMillis saturates to Long.MAX_VALUE; exceptionWait returns the user function's value unbounded.
The default (and only built-in) BlockStrategy is ThreadSleepStrategy; Thread.sleep rejects a negative argument with IllegalArgumentException before checking the interrupt status (JDK 8 through 21).
No caller-side guard: Retryer.call validates neither the sleep value nor catches RuntimeException around block; RetryerCallable.call delegates without a catch.

Not reported upstream as of 2026-11-26: rholder/guava-retrying issues and PRs (all states, including PR #107 closed 2026-09-05) and forks rhuffman/re-retrying and itning/guava-retrying3 were searched; both forks keep the same unguarded sum.
